title: When Opposites Become Causes: A Cross-Domain Science of Oppositional Causal Inversion
domain: metascience / causal inference / psychology / economics / organization science / international relations / information science / complex systems
summary: A cross-domain framework for testing when an increase in a construct causally increases a prespecified functional opposite after a change in actor, level, time, construct, feedback state, or capacity regime. Orwell's war-peace, freedom-slavery, and ignorance-strength triad is treated as a motivating stress test rather than as a conclusion.

aris.provenance: ARIS4C guided design with live prior-art audit and falsification-first framing
